remarks: Don't Miss This Hoyt Farm Charmer! Nestled at the end of a sought-after cul-de-sac, this pretty Colonial home sparkles with sophistication and charm. Phenomenal curb appeal, freshly painted interiors and a great floor plan lend themselves to easy, upscale living. Surrounded by mature trees, yet only minutes to town, this home offers both privacy and convenience in one of New Canaan's favorite neighborhoods. There are bright, generously-sized rooms throughout the house, with the family room and primary bedroom having soaring vaulted ceilings with skylights. Sunlit, chic and cheery, the house is beautiful inside and out with manicured landscaping and grassy play spaces. Relax on the inviting screened porch located right off the kitchen or serve dinner al fresco on the deck. In addition to everything this stunner offers, the Hoyt Farm Neighborhood Association is a wonderful way to meet new friends and enjoy block parties throughout the year!
